items.Sentence: The Facility headworks are located at Plant 1 and 2. Plant 1 is equipped with influent pumps and a mechanical screen and the emergency storage lagoon; the purpose of Plant 1 is to convey screened influent flow from Plant 1 to Plant 2. Plant 2 contains additional mechanical screens.

The Emergency Storage Lagoon can be used, if needed, to capture peak flows in excess of the Facility's peak design capacity of 2.35 mgd. This flow can be routed back to the Facility headworks for treatment after peak influent flows decrease.
The Facility's secondary treatment system consists of three parallel trains of oxidation ditches with anoxic basins, followed by secondary clarifiers.
Secondary effluent is treated using sand filters and disinfected via ultraviolet light prior to discharge to Old River via an upgraded multi-port diffuser.

Sludge handling takes place at Plant 2 and consists of an aerated clay-lined pond (referred to as an aerobic digester), three clay lined sludge lagoons, three belt filter presses, and four greenhouse solar drying beds.
